source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The setter purpose is identifiable. User/channel, policy, recovery and restore are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines a reversible account-authorization test and prevents guessed privileges, recovery-account modification or silent lockout.
independent_technical_reasoning: User access combines account/channel enablement and privilege ceiling; a command can succeed while leaving unexpected fields or testing the wrong identity. Independent recovery and a full baseline are mandatory because the account under test cannot be relied upon to repair its own access after a partial or over-restrictive write.
